title: The rehearsal's leaked-sandbox check counts only its own sandboxes
description: Timed wave of 2026-11-17: test_rehearsal.py's leaked-sandbox check failed whenever another agent's rehearsal had a sandbox open in the OS temp directory at the same moment, and agents slept to wait it out.
acceptance_criteria: The check counts only sandboxes this run created (for example, a per-run unique prefix or a recorded list), never every rehearsal-looking directory in the temp directory.
A test: a sandbox created by a concurrent foreign run during the test does not fail it; a sandbox this run leaks still fails it.
Edit examples/rehearsal/run_rehearsal.py and .harness/tests/test_rehearsal.py only. Run test_rehearsal.py only. Hand off to verifier.

notes.note: run_rehearsal.py: REHEARSAL_RUN_TAG names the sandbox harness-rehearsal-<tag>-XXXX (tag sanitized). test_rehearsal.py: default and keep tests tag their subprocess and glob only that tag; new tests for foreign-vs-own sandbox and tag sanitizing. test_rehearsal.py: 25 passed.

Verifier replay: test_rehearsal.py 25 passed. Mutant checks (skip own sandbox removal; foreign untagged sandbox during run) not done: the data-loss guard blocked the throwaway-copy setup commands, so no verdict. Needs a human-approved mutant run or a coordinator ruling.

VERIFIED by the coordinator (distinct from the producer). Mutant in a kept throwaway copy (rehearsal never removes its own sandbox, TMPDIR inside the copy): test_rehearsal.py fails, 1 failed 24 passed, and the alone retry fails too. Live replay: fast_tests.py test_rehearsal.py gives 25 passed. Foreign untagged and other-tag sandboxes are covered by the new test, which passes. The earlier verifier was stopped by the data-loss guard; this copy deletes nothing.
